Remark
[Known compact Ricci-flat examples (Remark 35.11)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0306 1. ch35:35.11\group Linear Stability

All known compact Ricci-flat examples have special holonomy and hence are linearly stable by the parallel-spinor theorem.
